full_span_api.behavior: Calls the implementation with decisive_only=false and returns full reduced rows.

solver_consumer.behavior: Specialized consumer requests contradiction/forced-variable consequences. The implementation selects linear-tail reduction by default when decisive_only is true and n_vars>=24, with explicit environment overrides.

linear_tail.behavior: Echelonizes high-degree columns and fully reduces only the linear/constant row-space intersection.

caller.behavior: MatrixF4/MatrixF5 choose full readback only for the legacy override; otherwise call the specialized consumer.

implication: The present full-RREF standalone workload is not a substitute for the specialized solver path. Future claims about that consumer need its existing linear-tail and flat-storage controls. No solver or curve workflow was executed or modified.
